description: This Java source file defines the ImePreferences class, which is a PreferenceActivity for displaying and managing input method editor (IME) preferences within an Android application. It includes an inner class 'Settings' that extends InputMethodSettingsFragment to load preferences from an XML resource.

classes.name: ImePreferences
classes.description: An activity that displays IME preferences, allowing users to modify input method settings.

classes.name: ImePreferences.Settings
classes.description: A nested fragment class that loads specific input method preferences from XML.

methods.name: getIntent
methods.description: Returns an Intent that specifies which fragment to display in the activity, setting 'Settings' fragment and no headers.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets a custom title for the preferences screen.

methods.name: isValidFragment
methods.description: Validates if the provided fragment name matches the 'Settings' fragment.

methods.name: Settings.onCreate
methods.description: Loads the preferences from an XML resource and sets titles for preference categories.
